_comment: THE ADMISSION SEARCH OVER THE 167 IEA ENTRIES IN THE CLASS `not searched by eufabric`,
run 10 September 2026. The class was named for a search nobody had run; this file is that
search. One record per benchmark entry, every fetch on it with domain, source type and
outcome, and one of three verdicts:
owner or permit source names the site  a source this register READ - the company's own
page, a permit, a grant register, a port or a
municipality - names the place of the works.
searched, none found                   sources were fetched and none of them names a
site for this entry. Includes the case where the
owner names a region, a sea area or two candidate
places and not one site.
source unreadable                      the natural owner or permit source was found and
could not be read: 403, 404, a dead domain, a
scanned PDF, or 200 with an empty body.
A BENCHMARK'S OWN FIGURE IS NOT A COMPANY'S. `outcome` says only whether somebody names
the site. Whether the entry then clears admission - electrolytic, in perimeter, and at or
above 100 MW on a figure its owner states - is a separate judgement, and the ones that
cleared it are in sources/hydrogen_candidates.json.
FETCH RECORDS WHOSE NOTE BEGINS 'MACHINE DOMAIN GUESS' ARE NOT PART OF THE SEARCH. They
are what a classifier produced by guessing a domain from a project name, before it was
read back and thrown away: it matched crane.com, a valve manufacturer, for 'Green Crane'.
They are kept because they were fetched and this register does not delete fetches. See
D42 in sources/hydrogen_docket.md.
PLACE NAMES UNDER `place` ARE REVERSE-GEOCODED FROM THE BENCHMARK'S COORDINATE AND ARE A
DISCOVERY AID, NOT A COORDINATE SOURCE. Nothing here may become a position on a row.
